name: veh-apc-floor-drive
note: E31 L9-S5: the mission APC at zero durability (floor policy) driving a straight 90 m line on autopilot, game camera following. Look for: it keeps driving (no stop, smoke or fire swap), smoke puffs follow the hull, wheels turn and stay grounded, no jitter or LOD pop, no wrecked shell. Gate: the vehicle reaches the end of the line.
